transcript: Five things you should keep in the forefront of your brain to make your week automatically better. Number one, you are where someone else dreams of being. Someone would trade places with you in a heartbeat. So before you complain, pause. You may already be standing inside a blessing you forgot to notice. Number two, live for tomorrow. Do something today that makes life easier for the version of you who wakes up tomorrow. Prepare your clothes, clean your space, write the list. Small acts of order create a peaceful life. Number three, romanticize the mundane things. Your coffee, your walk, your shower, your quiet morning. Do not wait for life to become beautiful. Bring beauty into the life you already have. Number four, gratitude. Before your mind starts complaining, thank God for what is still working. For the body that carries you, for eyes that see, for food on the table, for a roof above you, for another chance to become better. Number five, pay it forward. Be kind. Hold the door. Speak gently. Call your parents. Check on a friend. Tell people you love them while they can still hear it. And if your heart has been heavy lately, start the 30-day healing journey. It is waiting for you in the link on my profile.
